sections.title: One trained agent among bots
sections.summary: A PPO agent flies blue ship 0; the other nine ships are the built-in bot. After 3.5M training steps it beats the bot playing the same seat, on 50 battles it never trained on.

chart.alt: Training progress: the agent's average reward and kills per death rise past the bot's between 3M and 3.5M steps.
